text:
marta: Quick heads-up — saw a burst of errors in quota service where prefixed API keys (org-<id>-...) are being attributed to the wrong tenant bucket. anyone else seeing this?
devin: saw it around 11:04 UTC, looks like the router's prefix matcher fell back to the generic fallback path when KV read timed out.
sam: repro steps?
marta: curl example: `curl -H "Authorization: ApiKey org-42-abc123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — on a couple of requests the billing tag came back as "org-0" in telemetry.
tia: that sounds like the origin hash fallback we added last sprint. if the prefix lookup fails we default to origin=unknown which our billing layer maps to org-0. :grimacing:
sam: is this the same as the prefix ordering change we rolled last week? might be a race between cache invalidation and lookup.
devin: probable. router flow: 1) read local prefix cache 2) if miss, async fetch from config-store 3) use origin hash as fallback. If config-store slow, it'll use fallback.
marta: we should avoid mapping fallback -> org-0 for quota enforcement. that makes it look like a single tenant is spiking and can throttle everyone.
ops: regen alert hit the paging group. Paging notes show many false positives. We lost SLOs because quota throttles kicked in for org-0.
sam: proposed short-term: change fallback to a temporary ephemeral tag `prefetch-miss` and route those through a soft-limit not the org quota. Long-term: make prefix lookup sync with a cached negative TTL, and surface console telemetry for misses.
tia: agree. Console UX: expose a tiny "prefix-miss rate" sparkline on the quota page so teams can see if their keys are being misattributed.
devin: implementation plan: (A) router change to tag `prefetch-miss` & don't count against org quota (B) metric `auth.prefix_miss_total` + `auth.prefix_miss_by_key_prefix` (C) console panel + alert when rate > 0.5% of requests for 5m.
marta: also add a debug header when in canary: `X-Auth-Prefix: org-42 (resolved)` vs `X-Auth-Prefix: prefetch-miss` so support can triage without digging logs.
sam: can we avoid logging full API key in telemetry? we should hash the prefix for privacy, like sha256(prefix) and map in-house.
devin: agreed. metric label cardinality risk — only allow hashed-prefix and sample at 1%. Also add aggregation to the console UI so it shows examples of full prefix only when user is an org admin and clicks reveal (audit logged).
tia: rollout: feature-flag the non-quota fallback first in prod for 10% of routers, watch `auth.prefix_miss_total` and `billing.org0_throttle_count`.
marta: I'll open a tiny RFC and a rollout checklist. Need owners: devin for router change, sam for metrics + console tile, tia for rollout & alerts, ops for oncall runbook updates.
devin: assigned. I'll send a short PR with the header and tag changes, plus feature flag gate.
infra-bot: deploy-pulse: router-canary v2 queued for 10% rollout, change set includes auth-prefix-fallback-tag.
ops: once PR is up ping #eng-oncall so we can watch latency and throttle graphs. also update incident playbook to treat org-0 throttles as possible fallback artifact.
marta: thanks. small follow-up: add a synthetic test to our integration suite that simulates config-store slowness and asserts no org-0 quota increments. otherwise we might ship and regress.
sam: will add test. also adding a dashboard row: `auth: prefix miss rate`, `billing: org-0 throttle`, `router: fallback latency` grouped by region.
tia: LGTM. small UX ask for console: show a toast explaining what `prefetch-miss` means the first time an admin sees it. reduces support noise.
marta: perfect. I'll draft RFC and checklist now. tagging next steps in the ticket. :thumbsup:
